full_page.content:
Page 96
Dec. 16th John Sypien - 23 - beginning to drink intemperately - also Br. Frank Mrs. Sophie Sypien - 48 - mother of large Fam. invalid 12 yrs. Joseph Budziak - 24 - difficulty in speech
Mrs. Nell Koenig - 42 - operation - nerveous after serious opera- tion last Thursday.
John Perry - 46 - had fearful rhumatism ..... able to be around but not able to work ...
Mrs. Frances Bates - 24 - Husband indifferent about reconciliation
20th Anton Serra - 20 - bad company - dangerous hours - becoming way- ward - Enrolled To-day.
21st E'd Owens - presbitirian - Hodgkins disease ... specialists consider him hopeless ... Father went to Confession To-day Ist in 20 yrs.
Hugh McMann - 47 - operation ten days ago ... hopeless ...
Page 97
Dec. 21st Norman Gentile - 2 - born blind of Cath Mother - now in care of baptist - were here To-day.
Emil
Dec. 21st Rose Barbere - 20 - Goitre & stomach trouble.
22 Thanksgiving - Marie Maly - 16 - Enrolled Oct. 6 as case of hopeless Spinal maningitis and here Tonight practically O.K.
Mary Schafer - 40 - goitre .... fears operation: has not been well ...
26 Thanks - Jennie Blace - 30 - Thoride & heart - "Every-thing" - En- rolled Dec. 18 - a week yesterday - Comes Today smiling and aston- ished ....
Julia Bedfore - 4 - diabetis - down in bed with 8 times in year Enrolled
Cath. Mahoney - 63 - (Of LaFayette, Indiana) on her way last Satur- day ... Buick turned over twice ... having skidded ... no bones ... but
